elements.element: The renewal structure must use either renewal only by mutual written agreement or the permitted automatic-renewal alternative.
elements.evidence: The clause states that the Agreement may be renewed “only by mutual written agreement of the parties,” selecting the first permitted structure.

elements.element: If the mutual-agreement renewal route is used, renewal must require the written agreement of both parties.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires “mutual written agreement of the parties.”

elements.element: If automatic renewal is used, each automatic renewal term must be 12 months.
elements.evidence: The clause does not use automatic renewal; it requires mutual written agreement. The condition triggering this automatic-renewal requirement is therefore demonstrably absent.

elements.element: If automatic renewal is used, Customer must be able to opt out by giving 30 days’ notice.
elements.evidence: The clause does not use automatic renewal, so this conditional opt-out requirement is not triggered.

elements.element: If automatic renewal is used, Vendor must provide a reminder 60 days before renewal.
elements.evidence: The clause does not use automatic renewal, so this conditional reminder requirement is not triggered.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase must be capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
elements.evidence: The clause states that any renewal fee increase “shall not exceed the lesser of the increase in CPI over the prior period and three percent (3%).”
Renewal is not automatic; it requires mutual written agreement of the parties.

elements.element: The required non-renewal notice window must be no more than 60 days.
elements.evidence: The clause provides no automatic-renewal non-renewal notice right or notice window.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase must not exceed 5%.
elements.evidence: The lesser-of-CPI-and-3% cap necessarily limits increases to no more than 3%, which is within the 5% fallback cap.

result.reason: The redline satisfies the preferred mutual-written-agreement alternative and includes the required CPI/3% price cap. The automatic-renewal safeguards are inapplicable because automatic renewal is expressly excluded. It does not satisfy the fallback independently because it creates no automatic renewal or non-renewal notice window. The edit is not minimal because it also imposes 12-month renewal periods, which are required only for the automatic-renewal alternative, not the selected mutual-agreement route. Unrelated termination and payment provisions remain effective, although the clause retains redundant extension provisions and the defective phrase “mutual written of the parties.”
